review: Plan.Codigo is unique and non-empty; PlanLimite uses the owned composite key PlanId+Clave.
Suscripcion persists EmpresaId and PlanId with RESTRICT foreign keys, preserving historical records across tenant/catalog deletion attempts.
The migration enforces enum values 1..4 and a valid subscription period; PlanLimite null means unlimited and positive values are enforced.
Down removes child tables before Planes; no backfill is required because N6.9.B introduced new domain types without pre-existing relational rows.
A directed EF model contract test verifies tables, keys, indexes, ownership and tenant/plan foreign-key delete behavior.
